baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah explicitly orders the search: their vessels first, the brother's vessel later, extraction after delay, and taking under the king's din only by a divine exception.
baseline_models.mechanism: Postponing the target vessel converts prior placement into apparently discovered evidence. The sequence makes capture look procedurally generated while the ayah simultaneously says that royal jurisdiction by itself could not produce the taking.

activation_trace.role: An initiated and prioritized action supplies the deliberate opening of the evidentiary sequence.
Material containment supplies the repeated search units and the final site of disclosure.
Temporal precedence makes delay, rather than mere location, part of the proof-producing mechanism.
Disclosure from concealment turns a hidden object into publicly usable evidence.
Calculated indirection names the sequence as designed rather than accidental.
Seizure and detention identify the practical result that the staged evidence must enable.
An order of obedience supplies the operative royal regime whose normal reach is declared insufficient.
Royal sovereignty locates the legal constraint within a human jurisdiction.

changed_reading.before: A search happens to find an object and therefore permits the brother's detention.
changed_reading.after: The ordered search is evidentiary engineering: delayed disclosure manufactures a credible route to a detention that the king's regime alone could not authorize.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah repeats vessels, extracts what was inside, and closes with every possessor of knowledge having a knower above.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same root inventory permits a vessel to hold an object and an interior faculty to hold meaning. Extraction therefore stages a passage from concealed possession to manifested sign, while the closing hierarchy keeps every visible disclosure nested inside superior knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Interior retention of meaning lets the physical vessels also model unequal holdings of knowledge.
Concrete containment keeps the epistemic model anchored in the searched baggage.
Making the concealed visible supplies the transition from private knowledge to public sign.
Disclosure to a knower frames the scene as an asymmetry of apprehension, not only possession.
A distinguishing trace makes the extracted object function as the mark by which a status becomes legible.
Superiority of rank turns separate holdings of knowledge into an open-ended vertical ordering.
Comprehensive inclusion prevents any human possessor of knowledge from standing outside the hierarchy.

changed_reading.before: The vessels are physical props, followed by a detached maxim about knowledge.
changed_reading.after: The physical disclosure enacts nested epistemic containment: an object, its meaning, and each knower remain held within a higher field of knowledge.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah moves from Yusuf's procedural acts to 'We devised for Yusuf,' then from the king's din to God's will.
baseline_models.mechanism: The grammar distributes rather than collapses agency. Yusuf performs the search, the divine voice attributes the enabling design to itself, royal order sets a real limit, and divine willing opens an exception. The act can therefore be simultaneously humanly executed, legally constrained, and divinely enabled.

activation_trace.role: Intensive handling supplies the labor of arranging circumstances without reducing it to a single trick.
Indirect design accounts for how the desired result is reached through a staged route.
The denied possibility marks the legal inability as an actual condition of the scene.
Custodial seizure is the concrete result over which the jurisdictions differ.
Rule backed by dominion gives the king's din coercive reality rather than treating it as an empty label.
Effective willing supplies the stated exception and later governs elevation as well.
The divine referent fixes the exceptional agency above human sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The verse simply credits God with Yusuf's clever stratagem.
changed_reading.after: The verse preserves a stack of agencies and jurisdictions: Yusuf executes, royal law constrains, divine design enables, and divine will alone opens the legal possibility.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Beginning, before, then, extraction, taking, raising degrees, and above form one continuous sequence of ordered movement.
baseline_models.mechanism: The brother is reached one vessel at a time while Yusuf is described as raised by degrees. The final elevation can retrospectively name the form of the scheme: advancement and taking occur through controlled stages, not through an immediate leap.

activation_trace.role: A marked beginning establishes the first step of an ordered progression.
Precedence supplies the relative ordering that prevents the action from collapsing into one moment.
Incremental approach or taking makes the stated degrees echo the search's staged mechanics.
Elevation in standing gives the procedural ascent a consequential human result.
Higher rank extends the stepwise structure into the closing hierarchy.
Knowledge supplies the dimension along which the final hierarchy exceeds the visible procedure.

changed_reading.before: The search sequence and the statement about raised degrees are separate narrative and theological units.
changed_reading.after: The search itself has the shape of degrees: staged taking becomes the local procedural image through which Yusuf's elevation and the hierarchy of knowing are disclosed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening encounter establishes that Yusuf can identify the brothers while they cannot identify him. In the focus search, the party who knows the hidden arrangement controls when a trace becomes recognizable to everyone else.

activation_trace.role: Recognition by an identifying trace supplies Yusuf's initial informational advantage.
Failure of recognition supplies the brothers' contrasting dependence on whatever evidence is later shown.
Held interior knowledge anchors the asymmetry in the focus ayah's repeated containment language.
Controlled disclosure explains how unilateral knowledge is converted into a shared visible finding.
The closing hierarchy makes unequal knowing a governing feature of the scene.

structural_cues: 12:58 directly juxtaposes Yusuf's recognition with the brothers' nonrecognition; 12:76 ends a controlled disclosure with a hierarchy of knowers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one-sided recognition and later staged disclosure; I infer that the search preserves Yusuf's information advantage until it can appear as public discovery. A live alternative is that 12:58 only characterizes disguise and does not govern the later procedure.

changed_reading.before: The search conceals Yusuf's prior knowledge so that the brothers will not suspect him.
changed_reading.after: The search transforms one-sided recognition into collectively binding recognition: the superior knower controls when hidden knowledge acquires a public trace.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier bargain makes bringing the brother the condition for receiving measure. The later missing measure becomes the instrument for keeping the brother. The exchange reverses direction: first a brother obtains measured provision, then a measuring vessel obtains the brother.

activation_trace.role: Required arrival supplies the first direction of the transaction toward Yusuf.
Kinship identifies the person whose presence is made the price of renewed provision.
Measured food supplies the commodity initially obtained by bringing the brother.
The family's request to send the brother keeps kinship inside the provisioning bargain.
Withheld and sought measure makes the brother's movement economically necessary.
The missing vessel's measuring function supplies the object that reverses the earlier bargain.
A visible load of provision keeps the accusation tied to the economy of transport and measure.
The searched vessel is the hinge on which the exchange changes direction.
Detention supplies the reversed outcome: the measure now secures the person.

structural_cues: 12:59-63 repeatedly pair bringing the brother with access to measure, while 12:72-76 pair the missing measuring vessel with taking that brother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies both transactions; I infer a chiastic exchange, brother-for-measure becoming measure-for-brother. A live alternative treats the first as ordinary provisioning leverage and the second as an unrelated accusation.

changed_reading.before: The vessel is merely the evidence used to retain the brother.
changed_reading.after: The vessel reverses the whole exchange economy: the brother who once purchased access to measure is himself secured by a measure.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier object is deliberately placed in the travelers' baggage, later opened, found, recognized, and returned. The cup placement repeats that container grammar but changes its output: the first concealed payload returns the group, while the second permits one brother not to return.

activation_trace.role: Deliberately putting something into a new state supplies the first controlled placement.
Trade goods supply the first hidden payload whose later discovery redirects movement.
Travel baggage supplies the recurring mobile container.
Recognition from a trace gives the concealed payload a designed effect after discovery.
Opening a closure supplies the earlier reveal phase that the focus extraction repeats.
Finding a deliberately placed payload establishes discovery as a reusable narrative operation.
Return supplies the first placement's directional result, against which retention can be measured.
A second controlled placement marks the cup episode as a transformed repetition.
The same class of mobile baggage carries the second payload into the focus search.
Repeated material containment closes the earlier placement-open-find pattern.
Extraction supplies the second reveal, now with a custodial rather than commercial result.

structural_cues: 12:62-65 and 12:70-76 each run a placement-in-baggage followed by delayed discovery; their outcomes point in opposite directions.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two complete container episodes; I infer that the second is a controlled variation on the first and that changed circulation is its point. A live alternative is simple repetition of a successful tactic without a designed contrast between return and retention.

changed_reading.before: The cup placement is an isolated stratagem.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a repeated container script: concealment first makes goods and travelers return, then is varied so that one traveler can be retained.

context_deltas.mechanism: Before the focus, the brother is successively made the object of promises to guard, contested trust, a sworn covenant, delegated care, and finally Yusuf's shelter. The taking can therefore be read on two axes at once: public detention from the caravan and intimate transfer into refuge with his brother.

activation_trace.role: The brothers' promise of active guarding establishes one claim to custody.
Security and trust expose the fragility of entrusting a brother to the same group again.
A confirmed covenant formalizes the family's custodial obligation.
One who sufficiently undertakes an affair places human guardianship under a higher delegated care.
Gathering someone into shelter supplies the inward relational destination of the later detention.
Compassion toward one under care prevents the public seizure from exhausting the act's relational meaning.
Repeated kinship anchors both the caravan's claim and Yusuf's shelter in the same person.
Public detention supplies the outer legal form of the custodial transfer.

structural_cues: 12:63-66 accumulates promises and guarantees about guarding the brother; 12:69 places him in Yusuf's shelter before 12:76 describes taking him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rival care claims and immediate shelter; I infer that detention effects a custody transfer and has a refuge-side meaning for the brother. A live alternative is that shelter only reassures him and does not change the juridical meaning of the later taking.

changed_reading.before: Yusuf arrests his brother through a staged accusation.
changed_reading.after: The same act is arrest from the caravan's public viewpoint and refuge from the brothers' private viewpoint, transferring custody between competing guardianships.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father's covenant contains an exception for total encirclement; the focus contains an exception to royal legal inability through divine willing. Between them stands the assertion that judgment belongs to God and that affairs are entrusted to Him. Human commitments and royal rules are real, but each is bounded by a higher condition.

activation_trace.role: The solemn undertaking supplies the first binding human rule.
Overpowering enclosure supplies the explicit exception that limits the covenant.
Judgment between people supplies the jurisdiction explicitly reserved to God.
Handing an affair over to another marks the practical response to limits on human control.
The king's order supplies the second binding human rule.
Royal authority fixes the lower jurisdiction whose limits are being exposed.
Divine willing supplies the focus ayah's explicit higher-order exception.

structural_cues: The 'except that' boundary in 12:66 precedes the 'except that' boundary in 12:76, and 12:67 places judgment and reliance with God between them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel exception structures and the intervening claim about judgment; I infer a nested model of jurisdiction in which each human rule has a stated limit. A live alternative reads the clauses as separate expressions of piety without a shared legal architecture.

changed_reading.before: God's will is an isolated exception allowing Yusuf to bypass the king's law.
changed_reading.after: The focus completes a sequence of bounded rules: covenant, precaution, and royal law operate, yet each sits inside a higher jurisdiction that determines where its obligation ends.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jacob disperses the brothers across multiple entrances rather than one gate. The focus search inverts that distribution by ordering all their separate vessels into one serial procedure and converging on one selected vessel.

activation_trace.role: Repeated entry supplies the movement whose spatial distribution is meant to manage exposure.
Pluralized access points supply the father's tactic of dividing one arrival into several routes.
Avoided singularity defines the concentration of risk that the entrance plan rejects.
Deliberate scattering supplies the spatial form that the later search recomposes.
A collected plurality lets the separate owners and vessels be treated as one searchable set.
Initiating with the group supplies the procedure that recomposes dispersed entrants.
Serial precedence channels the many units toward one terminal vessel.

structural_cues: 12:67 distributes one group through many gates; 12:76 processes many vessels in a single ordered search ending at one brother.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies spatial dispersal and later serial convergence; I infer that the search reverses the earlier risk-distribution tactic by recomposing the brothers as one administratively legible set. A live alternative is that the gate advice and search order have no designed relation.

changed_reading.before: Searching the other vessels first merely protects the ruse from appearing targeted.
changed_reading.after: The search also reverses the family's dispersal strategy: separated routes and persons are recomposed into a serially governed set that converges on the selected brother.

context_deltas.mechanism: Jacob is described as possessing taught knowledge while most people do not know; the focus then refuses to let any possessor of knowledge become terminal. The hierarchy is therefore moving rather than dismissive: Jacob's precautionary knowledge is real, Yusuf's procedural knowledge exceeds the brothers', and divine knowledge exceeds every local knower.

activation_trace.role: Possessed, taught, and absent knowledge establish unequal but genuine epistemic positions before the focus.
Numerical predominance separates common unknowing from the exceptional taught knower.
The human collective supplies the broad field against which localized knowledge stands out.
Elevation of standing turns differences in knowledge into consequential differences in position.
Open-ended superiority prevents Jacob or Yusuf from becoming the final epistemic ceiling.
The repeated knowledge root explicitly carries the earlier contrast into the focus conclusion.

structural_cues: 12:68 calls Jacob a possessor of taught knowledge and contrasts him with most people; 12:76 repeats possession and knowing in a limitless above/below relation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two explicit knowledge distributions; I infer a local ladder among Jacob, the brothers, Yusuf, and God from their differing access to plans and outcomes. A live alternative keeps the final saying universal without assigning narrative positions to its levels.

changed_reading.before: The final maxim relativizes human knowledge in general.
changed_reading.after: The maxim maps the episode's live epistemic ladder: genuine human insight is preserved, surpassed by another situated knower, and finally contained by divine knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The object is placed as a drinking implement, publicly announced through a theft attribution, specified as the king's missing measure, backed by a guarantor, and finally extracted as a distinguishing trace. Its legal force is produced by successive social reclassifications, not by physical presence alone.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate placement changes an ordinary implement into a latent procedural trigger.
A tool for giving drink supplies the object's initial practical identity.
Public notification moves the object's status from private placement into a socially shared claim.
Attributing theft attaches an accused identity to the caravan before the search.
Seeking an absent object converts accusation into a question answerable by search.
The named measure supplies the object's quantifying and container function.
Royal ownership gives the missing object public institutional weight.
Assumed guarantee stabilizes the announced claim as an actionable undertaking.
The brothers' denial of corrupt purpose shows that the object's discovery will adjudicate a contested moral identity.
Final disclosure activates all the labels accumulated around the object.
A distinguishing mark explains why extraction can make an accused status appear known.

structural_cues: 12:70-72 successively present the same item as placed drinking implement, stolen object, missing royal measure, and guaranteed claim before 12:76 reveals it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies each relabeling; I infer that institutional proof is assembled through those labels and only completed by extraction. A live alternative treats the labels as redundant descriptions of a self-evidently incriminating object.

changed_reading.before: Extraction reveals preexisting proof of theft.
changed_reading.after: Extraction completes a manufactured proof-object whose force was built in stages: implement, royal property, publicly missing measure, theft-token, and finally visible mark.

context_deltas.mechanism: Asked for the consequence if they are lying, the brothers state that the person in whose baggage the object is found is himself the consequence. Their answer supplies the operative sanction that the focus says was unavailable under the king's din.

activation_trace.role: A requested matching consequence opens a space for the travelers to specify the sanction.
Repeated equivalence between act and consequence makes their answer function as a rule.
One entity standing in place of another supplies the formulation in which the found person becomes the penalty itself.
Finding fixes the factual condition that activates the travelers' proposed rule.
The travel bag defines the jurisdictionally relevant location of the finding.
Detention is the outcome for which the newly supplied sanction creates a route.
The king's operative order supplies the legal baseline that could not independently yield this result.
Royal sovereignty clarifies why an alternate norm has to be elicited rather than assumed.

structural_cues: 12:74 asks the brothers to state the sanction; 12:75 has them make the found person the sanction; 12:76 immediately explains that the king's din would not have allowed Yusuf to take him.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies their rule and the focus's statement of royal insufficiency; I infer that eliciting their answer imports the usable norm into the procedure. A live alternative gives all causal force to divine willing and reads their answer as narrative detail rather than jurisdictional transfer.

changed_reading.before: The planted object creates a factual pretext for arrest.
changed_reading.after: The procedure first induces the brothers to author the sanction and then satisfies its factual condition, generating a legal route unavailable within the king's own order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for ج ز ي, so it is surprising and must not be presented as the lexical meaning of the Qur'anic form. It remains anchored because the stated recompense immediately effects the brother's removal from his bonded group; downstream prose should call it a form-distant severance echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus takes an explicitly named brother out of the searched group immediately after the brothers define his being found as the recompense.

activation_trace.role: The split target's severing image supplies an exploratory material analogue for the sanction's removal of one member.
A binding tie makes the legal consequence legible as cutting and reassigning a relation.
Detention supplies the concrete separation from the caravan.

changed_reading.before: The recompense is a penalty applied to an individual.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory split-root echo, the recompense also cuts a lateral kin bond, separating one brother from the caravan so that custody can be reassigned.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The bone-repair branch is distant from the surface sense of the repeated vessels, so it should remain a metaphorical activation rather than a gloss. It is still anchored by the shared focus root, the threefold brother reference, and the scheme's production of reunion through procedural distortion; downstream prose should qualify it as a crooked-repair image.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The same ayah repeats the vessel root, repeatedly names the brother, and uses an indirect scheme to bring the brothers together under changed custody.

activation_trace.role: A break knitting back together, even off-axis, supplies the family-repair analogue.
Repeated kinship keeps the repair image attached to the fractured sibling relation.
Indirect design accounts for why the mending proceeds through a morally and legally crooked-looking route.
Compassionate shelter supplies the reparative destination that contains the public accusation.

changed_reading.before: The scheme secures reunion by a deceptive legal maneuver.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the scheme is a crooked splint: it rejoins fractured brotherhood through a procedure whose visible alignment remains distorted.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Reading the branch's box or drawer image into درجات is cross-domain and cannot replace the ordinary rank sense. It remains worth carrying because the ayah begins with nested material containers and ends with ranked knowledge; downstream prose should render it only as a structural container echo.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus moves from searched vessels and extraction to raised degrees and knowers above knowers within one ayah.

activation_trace.role: Concrete vessels establish the opening field of nested containment.
A compartment that holds things supplies an exploratory bridge from material vessels to ranked levels.
Elevation turns the compartment image into a vertical ordering rather than simple storage.
Knowledge supplies what is figuratively nested in the higher and lower compartments.

changed_reading.before: The verse leaves physical containers behind when it turns to abstract ranks of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: As a contained structural echo, the ranks resemble successively higher drawers: each apparent disclosure is itself held inside a superior compartment of knowing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The animal-husbandry branch under د ر ج is highly remote from the surface plural 'degrees' and must never be asserted as its direct sense. It remains anchored because that branch models an inserted surrogate sign that induces changed acceptance, precisely the functional pattern linking the planted vessel to altered kin custody; downstream prose should label it an unusual cross-domain mechanism.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: A planted item inside the brother's baggage causes a social and legal order to accept a new custody outcome, and the focus itself contains the activating د ر ج root.

activation_trace.role: An inserted surrogate token that changes acceptance supplies the outlier's exact causal pattern.
Deliberate placement provides the literal insertion event.
The ordinary drinking implement supplies the surrogate token that will be institutionally re-read.
Travel baggage supplies the receiving location in which the surrogate sign is planted.
Kinship supplies the social relation whose accepted custody is changed.
Detention supplies the newly accepted outcome induced by the planted sign.

changed_reading.before: The planted vessel falsely identifies a thief and enables detention.
changed_reading.after: In this highly contained branch activation, the planted token functions like a surrogate-acceptance device: it causes the surrounding order to ratify a changed kin-custody relation.

strongest_changes: The search order becomes a mechanism for manufacturing publicly credible evidence rather than decorative delay.
The brother-for-measure bargain reverses into measure-for-brother, and an earlier container-return script becomes a retention script.
The brothers author the sanction whose factual condition the search then fulfills, supplying a route unavailable under the king's din.
The same taking is both public detention and private refuge within competing structures of guardianship.
The closing knowledge hierarchy becomes the episode's moving ladder of partial knowers rather than a detached maxim.
summary.what_was_special: The ayah compresses containment, disclosure, kinship, seizure, royal law, divine willing, elevation, and knowledge into one mechanism. Context activates repeated containers, returns, measures, gates, covenants, and recognition so that several readings coexist: evidentiary engineering, reversed exchange, custody transfer, nested jurisdiction, and epistemic ascent.
remaining_uncertainties: The king's din may denote formal law, a broader royal regime, or customary obedience; the legal models do not require choosing only one.
The final degrees and knowledge clauses may directly interpret the search mechanics or may broaden beyond them; both the local and general readings remain live.
The split-root, bone-mending, drawer, and surrogate-acceptance outliers are packet-licensed structural resonances, not proposed lexical glosses.
